name: Christopher Trunkey
office: Saugus Union School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 5

items.text: Christopher Trunkey is the Saugus Union School District governing board member for Trustee Area 5, appointed in 2014. He has over 25 years of entertainment finance experience and is the executive vice president and chief financial officer at Phoenix Pictures. He served as a PTA volunteer and site council member at West Creek Academy and Bouquet Canyon Elementary, receiving the 2013 California State PTA Honorary Service Award.

sentences.text: Christopher Trunkey is the Saugus Union School District governing board member for Trustee Area 5, appointed in 2014.
He has over 25 years of entertainment finance experience and is the executive vice president and chief financial officer at Phoenix Pictures.
He served as a PTA volunteer and site council member at West Creek Academy and Bouquet Canyon Elementary, receiving the 2013 California State PTA Honorary Service Award.

items.text: His priorities include expanding hands-on learning, mental health supports and maintaining safe schools. He supports Proposition 3. He says artificial intelligence in elementary classrooms should be heavily restricted. To attract teachers, he suggests workforce housing and advocating for state financial aid. He says the board's role is transparent governance and collaborative goal-setting.
